question: In February 2020, the Kerala Chief Minister launched a mobile application named 'Yodhavu' (Warrior). The purpose of this application is combating:
solution:
The correct answer is __**drug menace**__.

__
 
• **In February 2020, the Kerala Chief Minister launched a mobile application named 'Yodhavu' (Warrior). The purpose of this application is to combat the drug menace.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Yodhavu' (Warrior) **is a mobile app through which the public can inform police about drug abuse and its distribution.
 
• It was launched by **Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan.**
 
• The main aim of launching the app is **to curb the growing menace in the State.**
 
• In this app, the informer's identity is kept secret.
